title: Eclair protocol 1.0.0-draft
description: Generated from openapi.json by `npm run generate`. Reference a definition with `urn:eclair:protocol:v1#/$defs/<name>`.

TaskName.description: Name of a task in a job. It is also the name of its outputs: the handle the application reads.

OperationName.description: Name of an operation, `<domain>.<action>` or `probe`, optionally with a major version: `video.hls@1`. Without a version, the latest one.

PresetName.description: Name of a preset. A `/` groups presets: `mediatheque/video`.

StorageName.description: Name of one of the project's storages. `eclair` is Eclair's temporary storage, available to every project.

Kind.description: Kind of a file, detected from its content.

Metadata.description: Free object of the client, returned as is in the job and the webhooks.

url.description: `https` URL of the file, for example a presigned URL. Fetched through the SSRF guard.

Input.description: The file to process: a URL, a path in one of the project's storages, or an upload.

StoragePath.description: Path in a storage, without a leading `/`.

MimeHint.description: The mime type the client expects. A hint: Eclair detects the real one from the content.

SizeHint.description: The size in bytes the client expects. A hint, checked against the project's limits before downloading.

OutputTarget.description: Where output files are written. Optional when no task writes files.

prefix.description: Prefix of every output path, usually ending with `/`.

path.description: Pattern of each output file's path, after the prefix. `{task}` is the task's name, `{file}` the file's name.

TaskCondition.description: Runs the task only if the probed input matches every given condition. Otherwise the task is `skipped`.

mime.description: Mime types, with `*` for a subtype: `image/*`.

from.description: Name of the task whose output is this task's input. Defaults to the job's input. `h264:file` picks one output file of that task.

options.description: Validated against the operation's options schema (see `GET /v1/operations`).

after.description: Extra dependencies, for ordering without using an output.

keep.description: `false` for an intermediate output, deleted when the job ends.

JobRequest.description: A job: an input, where to write the outputs, and a pipeline: a preset, inline tasks, or both. Without a preset, `tasks` is required. Tasks with the same name as a preset's task replace it.

webhook.description: URL called when the job ends. Defaults to the project's webhook.

failFast.description: Cancel the remaining tasks as soon as one fails.

TaskErrorCode.description: Stable error code: `input_unreadable`, `unsupported_input`, `timeout`, `limit_exceeded`, `operation_failed`, `storage_failed`, `provider_failed`, and `dependency_failed` when a task it depends on failed. New codes can be added: treat unknown ones as `operation_failed`.

name.description: Name of the file within the task's outputs.

path.description: Path in the job's output storage.

checksum.description: SHA-256 of the file, in hex.

role.description: What the file is for, when a task writes several: `main`, `thumbnail`, `segment`…

count.description: For files with many parts (HLS segments, a thumbnail series): how many parts are not listed.

url.description: Signed download URL, for files in the temporary storage (`eclair`): the bucket's presigned URL, or `GET /v1/files/{token}` when the temporary storage is a local directory. Not for end users: it expires with the file.

expiresAt.description: When a file in the temporary storage is deleted.

expired.description: `true` once a file in the temporary storage was deleted. It then has no `url`.

metadata.description: Data extracted by the task. Its shape depends on the operation: `probe` gives a `ProbeMetadata`.

op.description: The operation that runs, always with its version: `video.hls@1`.

progress.description: From 0 to 1, while the task runs.

preset.description: The preset the job used, and its version at that time.

tasks.description: Every task of the resolved pipeline, by name.

NextCursor.description: Cursor of the next page, `null` on the last one.

scope.description: `global` presets come with the server or the admin API, `project` presets are the project's own.

accepts.description: Inputs it can read. Other inputs are refused before anything runs.

Signature.description: `t=<unix time>,v1=<hex HMAC-SHA256>`. Several `v1` values can follow: the signature is valid if one of them matches.

type.description: URI of the problem type. `about:blank` when the status says it all.

errors.description: Validation errors: messages by JSON pointer to the invalid value in the request body (`/tasks/h264/options/codec`). The empty pointer is the body itself.

JobFile.description: A file of a job, with the task that wrote it.

ProbeMetadata.description: What `probe` reads from a file. Only what applies to the file's kind is present.

extension.description: Usual extension for the mime type, without the dot.

checksum.description: SHA-256 of the whole file, in hex, when asked for.

exif.description: A summary of the EXIF data. GPS data is never included.

timeout.description: Seconds to wait for the result before answering `202` with a job.

checksum.description: Add a SHA-256 of the whole file. It reads all of it, so it can take longer.

mime.description: Detected from the content, once the upload is complete.

complete.description: `false` while a resumable upload is in progress.

ProjectSettings.description: A project's settings. Every one has a default; limits not set use the server's.

concurrency.description: Tasks of the project that can run at the same time, over every worker.

maxInputSize.description: Largest input, in bytes. `ECLAIR_MAX_INPUT_SIZE` when not set.

maxDirectUpload.description: Largest file sent in the body of `POST /v1/probe` or `POST /v1/uploads`, in bytes.

taskTimeout.description: Longest a task may run, in milliseconds. `ECLAIR_TASK_TIMEOUT` when not set.

tempRetention.description: How long temporary files are kept, in milliseconds, at most `ECLAIR_TEMP_MAX_RETENTION`.

operations.description: Operations the project may use, by name. All of them when not set.

inputHosts.description: Hosts that `url` inputs may come from (`cdn.example.com`, `*.example.com`). Any public host when not set.

taskWebhooks.description: Sends a `task.completed` webhook for each task, besides the job's.

settings.description: Settings that differ from the defaults (see `ProjectSettings`).

webhookSecret.description: Verifies the webhooks and signed storage requests. Shown here once; `GET …/webhook-secret` reads it again.

settings.description: Merged into the current settings. A setting set to `null` goes back to its default.

disabled.description: A disabled project's keys are refused.

prefix.description: The start of the key, to recognize it.

token.description: The key, shown once: only its hash is kept.

StorageRequest.description: A storage's kind and configuration. `s3`: `bucket`, `region` (`us-east-1`), `endpoint`, `prefix`, `accessKeyId`, `secretAccessKey`, `forcePathStyle`. `http`: `url`. The configuration is encrypted and never shown again.

location.description: Where it points: `s3://bucket/prefix (endpoint)` or the URL.

cpuSeconds.description: Wall-clock time of the tasks, for now.

bytesStored.description: Bytes written to the temporary storage.
